name: Can not Drawing
source:
"Being too popular is scary."

It's been a decade since she first thought so. Sayori, whose beauty has always been a subject of admiration, has become a NEET to make her ideal otome game all by herself.

And now that some time's gone by, the greatest work of art has been completed!

It has, but, yeah... Something's not right.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/22817]Freem![/url]]
translation:
“太受欢迎是可怕的。”

距离她第一次这么想已经过去十年了。纱世里的美貌一向令人羡慕，如今却成为了一名尼特族，独自制作了她理想中的乙女游戏。

现在一段时间过去了，最伟大的艺术作品已经完成了！

确实有，但是，是的……有些不对劲。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/22817]Freem![/url]]
